user_purpose: 세 데이터셋에서 시간·수량 예측을 개선하는 TitanTPP Backbone 후보를 설계한다.

selected.hypothesis: 현재 문맥과 비슷한 과거 문맥 이후에 실제 관측된 시간 간격·수량을 개별 기록에서 검색하면, 일반적인 동일 사건 검색보다 다음 사건 예측을 개선할 수 있다.

alternatives.name: compressed_overwrite_memory
alternatives.reason: SurpriseGatedMemory already uses prediction-error outer-product updates; dual-timescale and Titans-MAC are prior related paths. Overwrite alone is not a distinct contribution; recurrence/scan complexity is higher.

alternatives.name: same_event_explicit_memory
alternatives.reason: Same outcome values, valid records, parameter shapes and initialization as candidate; keys use successor context rather than predecessor context.

alternatives.name: explicit_predecessor_successor_memory
alternatives.reason: Retains individual completed event associations, reads existing log event values, and adds the read after the existing encoder/static memory. No compressed innovation store or interlayer modification.

architecture.features: x_i = B.continuous_features(...)[i] = [log1p(max(dt_i,0)),log1p(max(q_i,0))]; exact existing float/mask semantics; no new centering, scaling, quantization or auxiliary target
architecture.placement: after unchanged two-layer encoder and original final static Hard-LMM; before both existing heads

projections.value: none; existing two-channel observed event features

architecture.read: a = stable masked softmax over available individual records; c_t = sum_(j,k) a_(t,j,k) x_k
architecture.state_lifetime: rebuild from each sample on each forward; no cross-batch, cross-series or external persistent cache
architecture.historical_window: same current loader history cap; does not extend effective context beyond supplied window
architecture.removed_redundant_factorization: Wv:2->16 followed by Wo:16->H would have rank at most2; direct U has the same linear value-map family with different optimization parameterization.

causality.prediction: query t is an observed event; next event is the target
causality.observed: mask & memory_write_mask; default memory_write_mask=mask only when all valid tokens are observed
causality.adjacency: Enumerate adjacent valid-event indices in original order, skipping padding. Keep a pair only when BOTH endpoints are observed. Do not bridge an interior valid-but-nonwritable token.
causality.record: (j,k), j<k, key from predecessor j, observed outcome value from successor k
causality.available_to_query: query valid and observed; pair observed at both endpoints; k<=t
causality.empty_record_row: return c_t=[0,0] before softmax; never evaluate softmax on an all -inf row
causality.one_record: ordinary defined read; query/key gradient can be zero because weight is1
causality.runner_target_dt: target_outputs masks target quantity but keeps target dt in input. Causal encoder plus completed-pair mask must prevent that target dt from reaching history queries.
causality.padding_scope: memory operator must be invariant under masked padding with fixed latent states; full encoder invariance only after existing right_pad_batch canonicalization because B has absolute positions

initialization.shared: B and both memory arms share exact baseline parameter tensors and source/runtime/data conditions
initialization.new: Both memory arms share W_Q,W_K,U initial tensors; create random new projections under isolated RNG, U=zeros
initialization.guarantee: Initial predictions, objective and loss gradients of shared B parameters match B before global clipping; memory output-map gradients are allowed.
initialization.limit: No equality claimed after first optimizer step: added U gradient may change global clipping; Q/K receive loss gradients only after U activates in a nondegenerate fixture.
initialization.no_extra_forward_or_rng_for_control: same dropout path and isolated loader generators

comparison.same_event_control: Same pairs, x_k values, query, masks, parameters, parameter initial values, residual route and data budget; only key h_j versus h_k changes. Control includes current k=t where valid; its key observation time differs by design.
comparison.exposure: same dataset split/targets, seed42, batch128,120epochs,noearlystop,sharedbatchorder; source/runtime identity to freeze after implementation
comparison.objectives: existing direct log1p quantity MSE plus existing legacy clamped time loss; no raw auxiliary loss or new quantity head
comparison.selection: earliest strict finite validation raw-RMSE minimum; RMSE,MAE,body,tail,time all at each arm's same selected checkpoint
comparison.endpoints: selected and epoch120, plus last30 RMSE mean/sampleSD; no mixing optimal checkpoints
comparison.mechanism_claim: Candidate must improve raw RMSE over the same-event control with the same guard criteria before attributing gain to predecessor-successor association. Gain over B alone only supports adding this module.
comparison.later_paper_evidence: component controls, measured compute, shared-head benchmark comparison and3seeds; final fixed model only then separately authorized held-out; current reused validation remains exploratory
comparison.gpu_contract: not created or approved by this design; future contract fixes exact source/runtime/server assignments/resources/deadline and authorization

cost.full_query_implementation: O(B*L*H*r) for projections plus O(B*L^2*r) attention and O(B*L^2*2) value read; ordinary attention storage O(B*L^2)
cost.memory_limit_of_estimate: score matrix only; not total peak memory or autograd cost
cost.fast_final_query_path: deferred; keeping one full causal API initially reduces equivalence risk

implementation_map.boundary: new explicit subclass encode_task_states; original default titantpp behavior unchanged
implementation_map.runtime_methods: existing forward/output/head contracts; no online inference optimizer
implementation_map.future_checkpoint_identity: separate candidate/control IDs and association mode, rank/normalization/feature/adjacency/fusion/source digests; reject relabeling

verification_required_before_gpu: independent completed-pair index oracle; padding skip and no bridging unobserved valid tokens
empty-row finite behavior; invalid query and zero/one observation
fixed latent keys+value sets+mask with pairing permutation changes nonzero read; do not use U=0 output as pair-dependence evidence
actual runner target dt/quantity future invariance under nonzero U, not loss invariance when target itself changes
initial B prediction/objective/shared preclip gradient and RNG equality
nondegenerate U then Q/K gradient flow; global clipping norm and AdamW update differences explicit
same init, batches, selector strict ties, inactive metadata rejection, optimizer/RNG/loader/selector save-restore
batch/sample/call isolation and exact streaming-prefix versus full causal reference
CPU actual model forward/backward cost followed by separately authorized CUDA qualification; no hypothetical runtime estimate

evidence.bounds: Previous failure mechanisms not established; differing historical selectors/budgets/reference B are not pooled numerically.

literature.title: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
literature.role: prior art for predecessor-match then successor-retrieval; LM findings are not evidence of TPP improvement

literature.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
literature.role: alternative compression/update tradeoff; no novelty claim for overwrite

literature.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
literature.role: prior associative-memory architectures; project's B static prototypes differ from paper's neural memory

refinements: explicit valid adjacency and target masking
control includes same currently available outcome values
